power_domains_summary.VDD1: First core supply (~1.8 V) — charge-pump / wordline / high-voltage core domain.
power_domains_summary.VDD2H: Second core / periphery supply, HIGH operating point — selected by DVFSC at higher frequencies.
power_domains_summary.VDD2L: Second core / periphery supply, LOW operating point — selected by DVFSC at lower frequencies for power saving.
power_domains_summary.VDDQ: DQ / IO supply, reduced to 0.5 V for low IO power.
power_domains_summary.Vref_ca: Internally generated reference for CA / CS inputs (per frequency set point).
power_domains_summary.Vref_dq: Internally generated reference for DQ / DMI inputs (per frequency set point / DVFSQ).

power_up_sequence: 2. Ramp supplies in the defined order: VDD1 (~1.8 V) → VDD2H / VDD2L → VDDQ (0.5 V).
3. Once supplies are stable, deassert RESET_n; wait the defined reset-exit time.
5. Program mode registers (FSP, RL/WL, bank mode, WCK ratio, link ECC / DBI, ODT / drive strength / Vref).
6. Run ZQ calibration; perform initial WCK2CK synchronization; train read/write timing for the active FSP.

low_power_modes_summary.Power_Down: Entered via a CA command (PD bit); no CKE pin; the mode lasts until CS next goes high.
low_power_modes_summary.Self_Refresh: Entered via SRE over the CA bus; DRAM generates internal refresh; CK may be stopped per the defined window.
low_power_modes_summary.Deep_Sleep_Mode: Lowest standby power; entered via SRE with the Deep Sleep Enable (DSE) bit; full re-initialization required on exit.
low_power_modes_summary.DVFS_DVFSC: Dynamic voltage/frequency scaling; DVFSC selects VDD2H/VDD2L per frequency set point; DVFSQ scales the DQ domain.
low_power_modes_summary.Write_X_Data_Copy: Write-X (all-zero / all-one) and Data-Copy commands reduce data-transfer activity to save IO power.

iDD_states_summary.description: Idle / standby current with banks precharged.
Precharge power-down current (entered via CA command).
Deep Sleep Mode current — lowest standby power.

dvfs_summary.DVFSC: Dynamic Voltage Frequency Scaling Core — selects VDD2H or VDD2L to scale the core voltage with operating frequency.
dvfs_summary.DVFSQ: Scales the DQ-domain voltage / Vref(dq) with the frequency set point.
dvfs_summary.FSP: Frequency Set Points (FSP-OP / FSP-WR) hold per-frequency RL/WL/ODT/Vref/DFE values, switched on a DVFS frequency change.

fields.notes: The defining LPDDR5 power features versus DDR3 are: (1) on-demand full-speed WCK / RDQS clocking (clocks enabled only when needed) rather than a continuously-running data clock; (2) VDDQ reduced to 0.5 V; (3) elimination of the CKE pin (low-power entry via CA command bounded by CS); (4) DVFS / DVFSC core-voltage scaling; (5) Deep Sleep Mode; (6) Write-X / Data-Copy data-transfer reduction. JESD209-5 Sections on power-down, self-refresh, deep sleep, DVFS, and IDD are the normative power references.
